description: Upload a photo or PDF of a UK parking ticket, council PCN, private parking charge, bus lane, ULEZ or Clean Air Zone notice. AppealGo reads it, identifies the issuer and contravention, finds the grounds to challenge it and drafts the appeal. Checking is free (fair-use cap per key per day); filing costs £7.99 or is covered by a plan, up to its appeal allowance. Provide image_url OR image_base64. Takes 20–90 seconds. Never invent notice details: report exactly what this tool returns.

content_type.description: image/jpeg, image/png, image/heic or application/pdf (for image_base64)

force.description: Scan even if this account already appealed the same notice

image_base64.description: Base64 of the photo/PDF (data: URLs accepted)

image_url.description: Public https URL of the photo/PDF

name: check_notice
title: Scan a parking ticket / PCN and get the grounds + draft appeal
